title: R8 v3: orchestrator/jev_sched.py — Jev as a shadow scheduling signal for soft-interference pairs only: batched, locked cache, [scheduler].jev_* keys matching promotion.FEATURES, fail-open, never overriding deterministic constraints; promotion evidence from decision rows (AP P15)
spec:
Why: waves are deterministic (interference.select_wave) and soft pairs are deferred or admitted by rule; AP P15 / brief P10 allow Jev to answer only ambiguous questions in shadow first, without O(n^2) calls. v3 after spec reviews T-0616 and T-0632.
What: new module orchestrator/jev_sched.py using jev.ask (orchestrator/jev.py:184; returns {answers:{key:{noul, confidence}}, usage} or None) and decision_log.record(kind='jev_sched'); plus promotion.collect('jev_sched') evidence. Tests are unittest.TestCase methods in the named files (this repo runs unittest; no pytest fixtures).
- PAIR_QUESTIONS = {'semantic_interference': {'type': 'noul', 'instructions': 'Probability that these two tasks change the same behaviour or interface and would conflict if run concurrently'}, 'stale_assumption_risk': {'type': 'noul', 'instructions': 'Probability that finishing one task first invalidates assumptions the other relies on'}} (jev.ask dict shape, as jev_route.QUESTIONS). ambiguous_pairs(pairwise_rows) -> only rows with level soft whose reasons contain no 'dependency:' kind; hard and none are never asked.
- cfg: flat keys on the existing [scheduler] table, matching promotion.FEATURES['jev_sched'] (table scheduler, key jev_mode): jev_mode off|shadow|active (default shadow; unknown -> shadow), jev_max_pairs 8, jev_cache_ttl_s 3600, jev_cache_max_entries 200; read via (pool_config().get('scheduler') or {}). No pool.toml edit; defaults in code.
- Privacy: per-pair state = {a, b, titles, scope (the tasks' scope path lists; paths are metadata and allowed), spec excerpts spec[:400] passed through jev.redact, interference reasons}; never file contents, diffs or worktree reads (the module performs no file or git reads).
- One jev.ask per annotate() call with at most jev_max_pairs pairs, questions keyed '<a>|<b>:<question>'. Per-pair confidence = None if either sub-question confidence is None, else the mean of the two (mirrors jev_route.classify).
- Cache: STATE/runs/jev/sched_cache.json keyed sha1(sorted pair ids + scope tuples + goal_head); read/write with the same fcntl-locked sidecar (.lock) plus tempfile.mkstemp + os.replace discipline as jev_route._cache_read/_cache_write; TTL and max-entries pruning; a different goal_head or scope misses.
- annotate(wave_result, pairwise_rows, tasks, *, goal_head, cfg=None, root=STATE, ask=jev.ask) -> {'mode', 'asked', 'cache': hit|miss|None, 'signals': {'a|b': {semantic_interference, stale_assumption_risk, confidence}}, 'would_defer': [ids Jev rates semantic_interference >= 0.7 for a pair with both members in the wave; the later one in wave order], 'applied': [], 'wave', 'deferred', 'error': None|reason}. off -> input unchanged, asked 0, no ask call. shadow -> computes would_defer, changes nothing. active -> moves would_defer ids from wave to deferred with reason 'jev:<a>|<b>'; only removes from the wave (never adds, never touches hard-deferred or dependency pairs, never exceeds capacity); any failure (ask None, malformed, value outside [0,1]) -> error set, wave and deferred unchanged (fail open).
- Every annotate call with asked > 0 or mode active records decision_log.record(kind='jev_sched', subject=<goal id of the first candidate or first task id>, candidates=pair keys, hard_constraints=['dependency', 'hard_conflicts', 'capacity'], deterministic={'wave', 'deferred'}, jev=signals, selected=applied, rejected=would_defer, reason, confidence=mean pair confidence, n=asked, mode).
- promotion.py: collect('jev_sched', root) reads decision_log rows of kind jev_sched via decision_log.read_all and returns {'n': rows, 'jev_disagreement_rate': share of rows whose would_defer (rejected) is non-empty, 'applied': rows with non-empty selected}; other features unchanged. Add one test in tests/test_promotion.py.
acceptance: tests/test_jev_sched.py::test_off_mode_never_calls_jev_and_returns_wave_unchanged — jev_mode off: ask not called, asked 0, wave and deferred identical

tests/test_jev_sched.py::test_shadow_mode_records_would_defer_without_changing_wave — a soft pair rated 0.9 lands in would_defer, applied empty, wave unchanged, a jev_sched decision row is written and the pair confidence is the mean of both sub-question confidences

tests/test_jev_sched.py::test_active_mode_defers_soft_pair_but_never_hard_or_dependency — active: the soft-pair task moves to deferred with reason jev:<a>|<b>; a hard pair and a soft pair carrying a dependency reason are never asked and never changed

tests/test_jev_sched.py::test_fail_open_and_single_batched_call_without_n_squared — ask returning None yields error set and the deterministic wave; with 12 soft pairs ask is called once with at most jev_max_pairs pairs and no hard or none pair appears in the questions

tests/test_jev_sched.py::test_cache_locking_invalidation_and_privacy — the same pairs and goal_head hit the cache (ask called once across two calls) and a .lock sidecar exists; a new goal_head misses; the state passed to ask holds only titles, scope paths, redacted spec excerpts and reasons (a marker planted in a scope file's contents never appears) and jev.redact was applied
tests/test_promotion.py::test_collect_jev_sched_reads_decision_rows — two jev_sched decision rows, one with a non-empty rejected list, yield n 2 and jev_disagreement_rate 0.5

constraints.interface_contract: annotate(wave_result, pairwise_rows, tasks, *, goal_head, cfg=None, root=STATE, ask=jev.ask) -> {mode, asked, cache, signals, would_defer, applied, wave, deferred, error}; ambiguous_pairs(pairwise_rows); PAIR_QUESTIONS in jev.ask dict shape; config [scheduler].jev_mode off|shadow|active default shadow, jev_max_pairs 8, jev_cache_ttl_s 3600, jev_cache_max_entries 200; cache runs/jev/sched_cache.json with .lock sidecar; decision rows kind jev_sched; promotion.collect('jev_sched') from decision rows; must not import daemon
